ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is an upper semicircle, with the diameter as a horizontal line segment, and the center O on the diameter. Let the left endpoint be A, the right endpoint be B, the point on the upper-right arc be C, and the point on the left arc marked with a 32° angle be D. In the figure, the 67° angle is at point B, that is, ∠ABC = 67°; the 32° angle is at point D, formed by DC and DO, that is, ∠CDO = 32°; the required x is the angle at point C formed by CD and CA, that is, ∠DCA. Reasoning: Because O is the center of the circle, OD and OC are both radii, and triangle ODC is an isosceles triangle. Therefore ∠DCO = ∠CDO = 32°. Thus the central angle ∠DOC = 180° - 32° - 32° = 116°, so the measure of arc DC is 116°. Also because ∠ABC = 67° is an inscribed angle, the measure of the arc AC it subtends is 2 × 67° = 134°. Arc AC is composed of arc AD and arc DC, therefore arc AD = 134° - 116° = 18°. Finally, x = ∠DCA is an inscribed angle, and what it subtends is arc AD, so x = 18° ÷ 2 = 9°.

raw_record.question_text: The diagram shows a semicircle with centre $O$. Two of the angles are given. What is the value of $x$?

method.method_draft: Label the left and right endpoints of the diameter as A and B, the upper-right point on the semicircle as C, and the left point on the arc with the 32° angle as D. Read from the image that O is the centre on diameter AB, the 67° angle is ∠ABC, the 32° angle is ∠CDO, and x is ∠DCA. Since OB/OC/OD are radii where relevant, triangle ODC is isosceles, so ∠DCO = 32° and hence central angle ∠DOC = 116°, giving arc DC = 116°. The inscribed angle ∠ABC = 67° subtends arc AC, so arc AC = 134°. Therefore arc AD = arc AC − arc DC = 18°. The angle x = ∠DCA subtends arc AD, so x = 18°/2 = 9°.

推理：因为 O 是圆心，所以 OD 和 OC 都是半径，三角形 ODC 是等腰三角形。因此 ∠DCO = ∠CDO = 32°。于是中心角 ∠DOC = 180° - 32° - 32° = 116°，所以弧 DC 的度数为 116°。又因为 ∠ABC = 67° 是圆周角，它所对的弧 AC 的度数为 2 × 67° = 134°。弧 AC 由弧 AD 和弧 DC 组成，因此弧 AD = 134° - 116° = 18°。最后，x = ∠DCA 是圆周角，所对的是弧 AD，所以 x = 18° ÷ 2 = 9°。

From the image, read x as the small angle at C between CD and CA; read ∠CDO = 32° and ∠ABC = 67°. Because AB is a diameter of the semicircle, ∠ACB = 90°.
